label: Original-phase input of v/j/k/m/a/1/b after an earlier g/o/z/r/3/x/f/p
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (99.9% of mass). It is silent at t=0 and weak at t=1, and the firing rate rises with position (0.28 at orig_idx 8). It is near-silent at the delimiter and during copy. The input token sets the rate: v (31%, the strongest, and the source of the top activations), then j, k, m, a, 1, b. It is also more likely when tokens from the set g/o/z/r/3/x/f/p came earlier in the sequence (first_tok g/o lift about 2.8x), and the gate essentially never fires when the input is one of those tokens. It favours the first occurrence of a token (90% of mass). This looks like a graded token-weighted plus history-weighted sum, so a boolean predicate captures it only partially (dev F1 about 0.55, mass recall 0.70). Many weaker activations fall on other tokens (h, y, n, d) in sequences rich in g/o/z/r.
